pages.title: Finding Ceruclase
pages.text: Default deposits: Nether, Y 0 to 127. Veins target up to 5 blocks, with 3 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 4.

pages.title: Working Ceruclase
pages.text: Smelt Ceruclase Ore or Ceruclase Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 103 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 4.$(br)Mining efficiency: 5.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 3.5.$(br)Enchantability: 16.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 4, chestplate 5, leggings 4, boots 3.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 0.0.$(br)Enchantability: 50.

pages.title: Weapon: Flash Freeze
pages.text: Has a 75% chance to completely freeze an enemy in place on hit for 3 seconds.

pages.title: Armor: Blizzard
pages.text: Mobs are slowed, fatigued and weakened depending on how much armor you wear, both players and entities are extinguished if they were on fire.

pages.title: Tool: Cold Snap
pages.text: Blocks will be mined instantly if they can be harvested and if they're harvested with the correct tool type.
